meta.title: Why Budgets Matter
meta.author: Portland Public School District
meta.description:
We’re breaking down the big stuff! We're giving you our district budget in bite-sized, easy-to-understand videos. Because budgets shouldn’t be a mystery they should make sense.

Find out:

Where our funding comes from
Our $40M shortfall
How your voice can shapes our budget 
And more!
Stay tuned for Part 2: “Where the Money Comes From” — coming soon!
